about_the_game:
Welcome to CUBES GO – Where Classic Block Elimination Meets Strategic Evolution!

 

Step into a dimension that redefines block-matching! Cubes Go transforms timeless puzzle fun into a dynamic 3D arena, powered by a deep, strategic Skill Tree system. This isn’t just about reflexes—it’s a journey of strategic growth, meaningful choices, and earth-shattering power!

 

Tailor Your Elimination Playstyle

Forge your own path with strategic upgrades:

→ Demolition Expert? Unlock instant screen-clearing Nuclear Strikes.

→ Survival Master? Earn Extra Lives and achieve Infinite Survival.

→ Resource King? Multiply Skill Points with Score Boosts and chain combos!

Every upgrade matters. Every choice defines your power.

 

Feel the Rush of Progression

Witness your evolution from struggle to dominance! Early challenges melt away as you:

→ Obliterate threats with planet-shaking explosions.

→ Reverse impossible odds with life-saving upgrades.

→ Dominate the grid through calculated power growth.

This is the core thrill of Cubes Go: From Zero to Hero.

 

Unleash Climactic Destruction

When your upgrades align, brace for pure adrenaline:

→ Trigger devastating chain reactions that make the screen tremble.

→ Watch scores skyrocket as blocks erupt in cinematic explosions.

→ Revel in the payoff of your strategic mastery!

 

WISHLIST NOW and ignite your block-shattering legacy!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows11
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400F
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
